card.name: Words just before a ruler or owner role
card.fires_on: Words in history or biography text that come right before a noun for power, rank or wealth, such as king, emperor, victor, president or heir. These are verbs like became, crowned, elected, or linking words like as and him.

modes.label: Becoming a ruler
modes.description: A verb or linking word right before a title such as king, emperor or president.
modes.example: The King of Qin<< became>> an emperor in 221BC

modes.label: Inheriting or winning
modes.description: A word before an outcome like victors, or before wealth or control after a death.
modes.example: His father died in 1657, leaving<< him>> a small fortune, and thenceforward

card.writes: It pushes toward words about owners, rulers and the rich, such as owner, owners, rich, wealthy.
card.plain: It fires when a sentence is about to name someone who gains a throne, title, control or wealth.
